senses.gloss: --a son of Asura Andhaka; to wreak vengeance on शिव for having slain his father, he entered the harem of शिव in the guise of a snake, and assumed the guise of उमा before him. He could change his form twice as he liked owing to a boon from ब्रह्मा; but the second change would be followed by death. On close examination, शिव dis- covered the figure to be the Asura in disguise, threw the Vajra and slew him. M. १५६. १२-37. [page१-151+ ३०]

--the sixth war of gods and Asuras.
1: Br. III. ७२. ७४.
In this Kakustha helped Indra;
2: वा. ८८. २५.
the sixth of the twelve incar- nations of Hari.
3: M. ४७. ३४-35 and ४४; वा. ९७. ८१.
